contexts.text: The inhabitants (of Venus) are to a large extent giants; the inhabitants of our Earth reach only to their navels. They are stupid... SE 1450.
This image (representing faith alone) appeared in the dim light like a great giant... TCR 810:end.
A Society of Heaven may appear like a giant or an infant; and this because the Divine is the same in the greatest and least things.
On the confines of the west we saw giants, double the size of ordinary men. They said... Ae are guards to the ancient western Heaven.
Hell is as one giant, a monster; and therefore to act against a single evil and falsity is to act against that monstrous giant... TCR 123:end.
He began to swell out... so that like a giant or Atlas, he could as it were reach to Heaven. SE 995. a.
When these (proud infernals) appear, they do not appear as giants, but as giants of giants...
They who are in the Hell of that Genii... want to appear as giants.
Universal Heaven, with the Church, before the Lord, is as one man, at pleasure... as a giant or as an infant...
The ancients meant these by the giants who attacked the camp of the gods... and were called the Cyclops.
